scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved directly by an all-order graph certificate, exact edge independence, finite union bounds, and Burnside orbit estimates. Finite program outputs corroborate but do not establish the infinite theorem. Independent external assessment has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The given sparse-density condition is sufficient, not sharp. A lower probability bound may be vacuous. Transfer to unlabelled graphs concerns uniform isomorphism classes, not arbitrary probability measures. Previously unindexed equivalent proofs remain a priority risk.
title: Star-core isometry orderings in random graphs and the almost-all distance-preservation conjecture
